title: Do not buy!!!
text:
Do not buy!!!. This is a horrible press! Doesnt work! Coffee grounds get through and doesnt even let the press go all the way down to PROPERLY PRESS THE COFFEE!
WONT LET KE RETURN? I DONT THINK SO IM CALLING AMAZON AND IM GETTING MY MONEY BACK!!!!
Spend the extra $3 and get another brand.

product_metadata.title: Mind Reader French Press Coffee & Tea Maker 27 oz, Glass
features: Large capacity: With room for up to 27 oz, this coffee maker is great for Sunday morning brunch with friends
Designed to avoid spills: The lid fits perfectly into the canister and with a twist, coffee won't spill out
Easy to use: Simply add coffee grinds to the canister and pour boiling water into it before topping it with the meshed lid, depress the plunger after 5-10 minutes and enjoy your cup of coffee
Durable and easy to clean: This plastic, steel, and glass French press coffee maker is made for daily use and can be hand washed with mild soap or placed in the top-rack of your dishwasher
Dimensions: This 27-oz French Press measures 6 long x 4 wide x 8.25 inches tall (24.765 x 10.16 x 21 cm) and weighs 1.27 lbs (576 g)
description: "Love quality coffee but hate paying for it? Love coffee but the coffee shops aren’t open when you want it? Looking for a small coffee maker without breaking the bank? The MIND READER French Press Coffee Maker is just what you need!Ditch the instant and make a quality cup of coffee from ground coffee beans, just like the cafes. Think how much money you’ll saving by brewing your own coffee at home! With this coffee maker, you don’t need to sacrifice the quality. This vintage coffee maker is tried, true. The MIND READER French Press Coffee Maker is not just for the home. It is convenient and easy to use so you can also put the French press in the office break room or bring it as a camping coffee maker. Just add quality coffee grinds, hot water, and you will be drinking that dark brew in no time.This is a great present for coffee lovers, coffee snobs, coffee aficionados, students, co-workers, family, and friends. Don’t forget the high-quality design. The French press is made of glass and uses stainless steel mesh for the filter.Get your own MIND READER French Press Coffee Maker now!"
